notes.title: Dead Beats Survivors is now available!
notes.content:
The 2D shooting survival game “Dead Beats Survivors”—where you battle hordes of zombies in a dark, underground disco, earn cash, power up your character, and endure until time runs out—is now ready for you to play!

To celebrate its release, we’re running a 40% off sale! Don’t miss the chance to experience “Dead Beats Survivors” for yourself!
